propositions: Production logic (~200 lines) in YAML run-blocks is untestable by ruff and has high defect density (7 recommendations); classification and alert-lifecycle state machines must be extracted to Python.

Four logic families (check-heartbeat, heartbeat-alert, check-binding-drift, binding-drift-alert) containing branchy decision logic and ${{ }} expressions differ in kind from CAS push loops and merit extraction with unit tests.
Both CAS push loops (reconcile-bridge.yml commit-back and canary flush) must remain in YAML byte-identical and verified by existing tests; only classification/alert-lifecycle logic migrates.
Anti-rot test must pin canary wiring (workflow invokes scripts/canary_bridge.py subcommands) and assert the flush loop remains verbatim with no new logic-bearing run-blocks.

Error handling disposition for each step must be preserved: alert WRITES fail loud (non-zero exit), dedup FINDs degrade gracefully to not-found, bridge-fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON signals drift not error, DRY_RUN gates both YAML and Python.
